landing.hero_subtitle: Analyze soil N-P-K, pH, and local weather to receive top crop recommendations, stage-by-stage fertilizer dosages, and research-grounded agricultural advice.
landing.core_modules_desc: Integrated precision tools supporting farmers and agricultural officers from pre-sowing to harvest.
landing.mod_crop_desc: Recommends highest-yielding crops based on soil nutrients (N, P, K), pH, and regional seasonal climate data.
landing.mod_fert_desc: Calculates exact chemical and organic fertilizer dosages (Urea, TSP, MoP, Gypsum) tailored to your land area with split schedules.
landing.mod_ai_desc: Real-time AI answering crop diseases, pest controls, and agronomic guidelines grounded in BARC, BRRI & BARI research docs.
landing.portals_title: Dedicated Workspaces for Farmers, Officers & Admins
landing.portals_desc: Tailored interfaces providing specialized workflows, permission sets, and telemetry.
landing.farmer_portal_desc: Localized weather, field-level fertilizer plans, advisory history, and 1-click PDF download.
landing.farmer_feat_2: PDF Advisory Export for Offline Record-Keeping
landing.officer_portal_desc: Audit AI responses, add field-level scientific notes, and track regional agronomic patterns.
landing.officer_feat_1: Audit and Resolve Flagged Advisory Feedback
landing.admin_portal_desc: Manage user accounts, officer verification, RAG knowledge indexing, and system security audit trails.
landing.admin_feat_1: AI Model Registry & Vector Database Re-indexing
landing.science_desc: Our machine learning models and RAG pipeline are strictly grounded in official publications from Bangladesh's premier agricultural research bodies.
